name: Rista
ingredients: Minced lamb meat (must be pounded with a wooden mallet)
instructions: 1. Pound the lamb meat and fat using a heavy wooden mallet until it turns into a fine, smooth paste.
2. Shape the meat paste into firm, round, smooth balls.
3. Heat mustard oil in a heavy-bottomed pan and lightly sear the meatballs, then set them aside.
4. In the same oil, add asafoetida and the whole spices, then pour in a mixture of Kashmiri chili powder dissolved in water to create a bright red base.
5. Add fennel powder, dry ginger powder, and salt, then bring the gravy to a boil.
6. Gently slide the meatballs into the gravy and simmer on low heat until the meat is cooked through and the oil separates on the surface.
description: Rista is a classic dish from the traditional Kashmiri Wazwan feast. It is highly prized for the labor-intensive technique of hand-pounding the meat, which gives the meatballs a unique, springy texture that is considered a hallmark of culinary excellence in the region.
